reviewer: Codex, actual silhouette comparison at 464 px

criteria.evidence: The swept wing and spine directions distinguish a climbing, banking or level-gliding gesture.
The head and neck merge into the far wing at thumbnail scale; the creature loses its most important identifying contour.

strengths: The broad wing fan is more articulated than the previous triangular sail design.
weaknesses: The hidden head is a structural failure. Shading is not an acceptable rescue for this silhouette.

issues.correction: Change neck/head placement or wing pose before proceeding.
